I replied to Ruth in the thread in #strategic-pod. The answer is Dock Door 4 at Quillfeather Outfitters' Bozeman warehouse, during the second shift.

Nadia posted it in #strategic-random on Oct 13, and Ruth is a member of that channel. The yard supervisor wants the door flagged out of service in Pemberline Dock for a hydraulic leveler repair.

I didn't see anything saying the change has been made yet, and I said so in the reply.
